3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The National Mausoleum, high in the hills above Porte Drazon, embraced me with its stately presence.
3.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Peace_NoDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_CouncilMeeting_VinaCalledBack"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_PostIncident_Peace_NoDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_CouncilMeeting_VinaCalledBack"] == true) == false)

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I was here for the annual Sovereign Memorial Commemoration, a ceremony honoring the former monarchs of Rizia, held just outside the mausoleum's entrance.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: The hushed corridors were adorned with statues and inscriptions of monarchs from eras long past.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: The mausoleum stood as a witness to the enduring legacy of Rizia.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I had also come to honor the memory of my late wife, Lena, whose resting place could be found within these hallowed grounds as well.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: Adjacent to it stood a bouquet of recently placed flowers, a weekly tradition per Vina's instructions.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: I took a flower from the bouquet and smelled it. The scent of roses still reminded me of her.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: As I stood in contemplation, reflecting upon our time together, a gentle voice called from behind.

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: She hadn’t attended a Sovereign Memorial Commemoration since Father’s passing.

16.speaker: Estela Toras
16.text: “At my age, surprises are as rare as non-gray hairs. Don't act as though my presence is some extraordinary revelation.”

17.speaker: Estela Toras
17.text: “And, for the record, I can still navigate these halls without assistance--”

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: Her eyes swept across the room, coming to rest on Lena's grave.

19.speaker: Estela Toras
19.text: “Forgive my lack of decorum. I should treat this day with the gravity it deserves."

20.speaker: Narrator
20.text: Gradually, she drew near, her eyes conveying unexpressed sentiment.

21.speaker: Estela Toras
21.text: “You of all people know what an extraordinary woman she was. Though I confess it took me a while to warm up to her."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: “What was extraordinary about her? She was just another entitled noblewoman."

23.speaker: Estela Toras
23.text: “That's what I thought as well, darling. At first."

24.speaker: Estela Toras
24.text: “I remember the exact moment my feelings toward Princess Lena changed.”

25.speaker: Estela Toras
25.text: “It was right after the civil war broke out in Wehlen."

26.speaker: Estela Toras
26.text: “Up to that point, I was adamant that Rizia should accept as few Wehzek refugees as possible."

27.speaker: Estela Toras
27.text: "The next day, I persuaded Valero to open our borders."

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: My mother reached into her handbag and held up a weathered envelope.

31.speaker: Estela Toras
31.text: “A love letter from your father -- the first one he ever wrote. I want to honor him by giving it back.”

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "That sounds like her -- placing compassion before practicality."

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "Lena and I never spoke about such weighty topics."

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "Love... now that's a word I rarely hear you say."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "You were her mother-in-law. There's always some friction in that relationship."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "How do you know she was extraordinary? You two barely spoke."

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "I didn't know you felt that way about her."

44.speaker: Player_Romus
44.text: "That's not surprising at all. Everyone who met Lena loved her."

48.speaker: Estela Toras
48.text: “A love letter from your father -- the first one he ever wrote. I thought it only fitting to give it back.”

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: My mother left the room, and I followed behind.

50.speaker: Narrator
50.text: We made our way down the great hall, past the resting places of the great leaders, and some not-so-great, who came before me.

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: It wasn’t long before the light from the Eternal Flame, a single torch placed at the late king’s sarcophagus symbolizing a monarch’s enduring reign, guided us the rest of the way.

52.speaker: Narrator
52.text: As we neared, my mother’s pace slowed as if waves of memories pressed upon her.

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: The flame's flickering glow cast dancing shadows on our path.

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: We stopped just before we reached my father’s stone encasing.

57.speaker: Estela Toras
57.text: “If you don’t mind, I’d like to say a few words to your father.”

59.speaker: Estela Toras
59.text: “Val... For 45 years, we walked different paths, our views often conflicting, and our words sometimes harsh."

60.speaker: Estela Toras
60.text: "But the love between us never waned."

61.speaker: Estela Toras
61.text: "So, in this space between the living and the departed, I speak these final words. My reserved heart lays bare the truth..."

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: She presented the letter to the flame, watching as it intensified, consuming the paper until it vanished.

63.speaker: Estela Toras
63.text: “May he rest in peace as his legacy lives on."

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: “Legacy... I doubt history will be very kind.”

65.speaker: Estela Toras
65.text: “I’m not speaking of his actions on the throne. His legacy is you.”

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: “A heavy burden to bear -- a name forever stained by the judgments of time.”

67.speaker: Estela Toras
67.text: “Legacies are shaped by more than just deeds. What you make of the name matters just as much.”

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: “I can't escape the shadows of his choices, no matter what path I forge.”

69.speaker: Estela Toras
69.text: "Maybe not, but you can cast new shadows that speak of redemption and resilience."

70.speaker: Estela Toras
70.text: “Sometimes, the most profound responsibilities are the ones we inherit, not by choice, but by destiny.”

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: “Destiny or not, I'll strive to leave a legacy that stands apart from the mistakes of my father."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: “My triumph over Pales will rectify his failure.”

73.speaker: Estela Toras
73.text: “Or be your undoing, just like him. His relentless pursuit of victory at any cost consumed him, as I fear it may be consuming you."

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: I began pacing around the hall.

76.speaker: Estela Toras
76.text: “So sure of yourself. I'll tell you what I do know... ”

77.speaker: Estela Toras
77.text: “I know that my son is determined to embark on some military expedition when his attention should be focused on the rightful restoration of Zille.”

78.speaker: Estela Toras
78.text: “I know that the very foundations of the monarchy have been put at risk through such actions.”

79.speaker: Estela Toras
79.text: "And speaking of risk... I've heard whispers about your *escapades* with House Azaro, a family harboring their own ambitions regarding the throne."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "If you insist, but please make it brief. I don't have all day."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "I find comfort in knowing that his legacy lives on, but it doesn't change the pain of his absence."

86.speaker: Player_Romus
86.text: "For better or worse, his legacy will live on."

87.speaker: Player_Romus
87.text: "Indeed. Recognizing the past's influence on the present is crucial, guided by divine blessings."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "Unfortunately, my father's and my legacies are intertwined."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "A reminder to choose our path with care."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "What matters is what I do, not what the name did."

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "I'll ensure the name stands strong, even if it means shouldering the weight alone."

92.speaker: Player_Romus
92.text: "My actions speak louder than any family name. I'll forge my path."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "Indeed, like divine threads in a grand design, guiding us toward a purpose beyond our choosing, much like Father."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "Father's path proved it's the choices, not fate, that shape our destiny."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "I'll embrace whatever responsibilities destiny throws at me, be it triumphs or defeats, much like my father."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "My victory over Pales will honor his memory by finishing what he started."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "God willing, my victory over Pales will honor his memory by finishing what he started."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "I appreciate your concern, but this time will be different. God is on our side. I can feel it."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "You can't see into the future any more than anyone else."

100.speaker: Estela Toras
100.text: "Farewell, until we meet where love knows no bounds."

101.speaker: Estela Toras
101.text: "The years may have etched lines on our faces, but they also deepened my affection for you."

102.speaker: Estela Toras
102.text: "My heart bears no bitterness. Instead, it carries the memories of laughter, shared moments, and a touch beyond words."

106.speaker: Narrator
106.text: Vina, of course, was by my side. Her demeanor had become much more solemn since her return from Pales. She clasped her hands tightly around the bouquet she was holding.

114.speaker: Narrator
114.text: I gave her some space to allow for a moment between the two of them.

115.speaker: Narrator
115.text: She spoke to him in a hushed whisper, for much longer than I expected.

116.speaker: Narrator
116.text: When she was finished, she took out the love letter and placed it on the sarcophagus. I took this as my cue to return.

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "I do mind. You could have said what you needed to say within the past four years."

121.speaker: Narrator
121.text: I stepped away, granting her some space.

122.speaker: Narrator
122.text: She folded her arms and scowled at me.

123.speaker: Estela Toras
123.text: "I was speaking rhetorically, Romus. I'll grieve as I see fit."

124.speaker: Narrator
124.text: She spoke to him in a hushed whisper, prolonging the conversation far longer than I anticipated.

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: When she finally concluded, she retrieved the love letter and let the flames of the torch consume it. Taking this as my cue, I returned to her side.

126.speaker: Vina Toras
126.text: "Feels like we were just here. I miss her so much."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "We all do, dear. She's always with us in our hearts."

131.speaker: Vina Toras
131.text: "I know. But I'm still filled with regret."

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "It's not your fault, Vina. You couldn't have predicted it. It was a tragic accident."

133.speaker: Vina Toras
133.text: "It was my own pleading that steered us into that storm. We should have never set foot on that boat."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "Your mother wouldn't want you carrying that burden."

135.speaker: Vina Toras
135.text: "But she would still be here if I hadn't asked her to go."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "We're here because it's what people do. They come, they remember, and then they move on."

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "Your mother's presence is timeless, and it's only right that we revisit this place."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "Yes, but time moves on, so we must as well."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "You were a child. I was the one who refused the trip. If I had gone, I could've been there to save her life."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "Blaming yourself for the storm won't bring her back."

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "The storm wasn't your doing. You need to move past this fixation with what could have been."

143.speaker: Narrator
143.text: It wasn't long before we reached her mother's tomb. Vina set the bouquet in a vase next to the sarcophagus, which had been encased in gold, as was tradition.

144.speaker: Vina Toras
144.text: "I gathered these roses from the Royal Garden. They're the absolute best."

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: We shared a quiet moment without words.

150.speaker: Estela Toras
150.text: “And, for the record, I can still navigate these halls without assistance, thank you very much.”

151.speaker: Estela Toras
151.text: "Vina! It's so good to see you. You're looking as lovely as ever."

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: Vina went to her, and they exchanged a brief embrace.

157.speaker: Vina Toras
157.text: "Speaking of which, I'm going to meet Manus for a short walk before the ceremony."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "We felt it would be more appropriate to limit visiting Lena to family only."

159.speaker: Estela Toras
159.text: "Hm. He didn't feel like joining you here?"

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: Before I could fully grasp the moment, she reached for my hand and delivered a sincere squeeze.

164.speaker: Narrator
164.text: I stared at the tomb, allowing memories of Lena and the boat accident to flood my mind.

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: We shared a quiet moment without words until a voice from behind caught our attention.

166.speaker: Narrator
166.text: I was on the verge of becoming lost in thought when a voice called to me from behind.

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "I understand. He's quite busy now that he's majority speaker."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "Lena would have hated to see her daughter dating a Sazon."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "What would be the point? Lena wasn't *his* mother."

170.speaker: Narrator
170.text: Despite the absence of romance, I owed it to Vina, whose captivity consumed my thoughts, to pay my respects.

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: Soon, I found her sarcophagus, encased in gold as per tradition. A heavy silence settled over me as I stood before it.

172.speaker: Narrator
172.text: I'd endured many sleepless nights since she was taken.

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: She reached out and took Vina's hand, giving it a gentle squeeze.

177.speaker: Estela Toras
177.text: “She was an extraordinary woman, your mother. I'd even go as far as to say she was like a daughter to me."

178.speaker: Vina Toras
178.text: "I wish I'd known her as well as you did."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "Bringing Zille back into our fold will rectify his mistake of giving it away so freely."

183.speaker: Narrator
183.text: As for Vina... the relentless thought of her captivity plagued my mind. I had hardly slept since she was taken.

184.speaker: Narrator
184.text: Hugo was overseeing the ceremony, and there was still some time before it was to begin.

185.speaker: Vina Toras
185.text: "Maybe for you, but it still feels like I'm stuck in a moment I can't escape."

186.speaker: Vina Toras
186.text: "Timeless, maybe. But sometimes it feels like the memories are slipping away, and revisiting only makes the pain worse."

187.speaker: Vina Toras
187.text: "That's easy for you to say. Regret is a constant reminder of what I've lost."

188.speaker: Vina Toras
188.text: "You don't understand. I still think about it every day."

189.speaker: Vina Toras
189.text: "But it doesn't make the guilt any easier to let go."

193.speaker: Vina Toras
193.text: "Acknowledging it doesn't make the guilt disappear. It's not that simple."

194.speaker: Player_Romus
194.text: "You were a child. I was on that boat, too, and I could have saved her life."

195.speaker: Vina Toras
195.text: "It's hard not to wonder, what if?"

196.speaker: Vina Toras
196.text: "So you do feel lucky to have me. You've got an interesting way of showing it."

197.speaker: Narrator
197.text: We walked the rest of the way in uncomfortable silence until we reached Lena's tomb.

201.speaker: Narrator
201.text: Vina, of course, was by my side. She was holding a bouquet.

203.speaker: Narrator
203.text: Vina said a silent prayer and set the bouquet in a vase next to her mother's sarcophagus, which had been encased in gold, as was tradition.

207.speaker: Narrator
207.text: In an instant, the memories of the boat accident came flooding back.

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: The deafening thunder that accompanied the torrent of rain, waves that tossed us around like rag dolls...

209.speaker: Narrator
209.text: But before I became lost in thought, my focus shifted back to Vina, whose captivity consumed my thoughts.

210.speaker: Estela Toras
210.text: "I agree with your father. Just because he's courting the king's daughter, it doesn't mean he has special privileges--"

212.speaker: Estela Toras
212.text: "Busy with what, dear? You know your father always called his party a zoo full of paper tigers--"

213.speaker: Estela Toras
213.text: "No, indeed. He'd be lucky to have a Rumburgian princess for a mother instead of that harpy--"

215.speaker: Estela Toras
215.text: "We conversed much more often than you realized. You were just too busy to notice."

216.speaker: Estela Toras
216.text: "It was only after you were married that my love for her grew.”

217.speaker: Estela Toras
217.text: "Believe me when I say that I did grow to love her."

218.speaker: Estela Toras
218.text: "Come now, you know I'm not one for garish displays of emotion."

219.speaker: Estela Toras
219.text: "But, yes, it's true. I did grow to love her dearly."

220.speaker: Estela Toras
220.text: "Not only that. I was common-born, and she was a Livingston. She was practically bred to hate me."

221.speaker: Estela Toras
221.text: "But somehow, she managed to completely defy my expectations, and I grew to love her."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "What's the use of a legacy if it doesn't change anything for the living?"

226.speaker: Estela Toras
226.text: "Sure, however, acknowledging the past can often guide us in shaping a better future."

227.speaker: Estela Toras
227.text: "A testament to how our actions reverberate through time."

228.speaker: Estela Toras
228.text: "The ache of loss may linger, but the impact he made will endure through the ages."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "Yes. Unfortunately, my father's and my legacies are intertwined."

230.speaker: Estela Toras
230.text: "You'd be wise to consider what imprint *you* wish to leave behind as well."

231.speaker: Estela Toras
231.text: "He may not have been a perfect man, but his responsibilities are now yours."

232.speaker: Estela Toras
232.text: "Yes, because our name carries weight, son. It's not just the actions. It's how you carry the responsibility that defines the legacy."

234.speaker: Estela Toras
234.text: "Actions matter, but how you carry the family name matters equally. Your choices will shape our legacy."

235.speaker: Estela Toras
235.text: "Our name carries weight. It's not just the actions. It's how you carry the responsibility that defines the legacy."

236.speaker: Estela Toras
236.text: "But you're not just living for yourself. The family name is a part of you, and its heritage is in your hands."

237.speaker: Estela Toras
237.text: "Don't underestimate the power of a name. Your actions reflect not just on you but on our family as a whole."

242.speaker: Player_Romus
242.text: "It's as if there are subtle forces at play, nudging us toward responsibilities we never chose but are fated to fulfill, much like Father."

243.speaker: Player_Romus
243.text: "His defeat in Pales is one of Rizia's greatest tragedies. That's why I aim to avenge it and restore honor to our house."

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: "His defeat in Pales is one of Rizia's greatest tragedies. That's why I aim to avenge it and restore honor to our house -- by any means necessary."

251.speaker: Estela Toras
251.text: "I'm concerned that your relentless pursuit to reclaim Pales may lead to a case of history repeating."

252.speaker: Estela Toras
252.text: "A noble resolve, but beware of letting it consume you and cloud your judgment, as it did your father."

253.speaker: Estela Toras
253.text: "Our family's honor was never lost. Even in defeat, your father fought with dignity."

254.speaker: Estela Toras
254.text: "That said, I fear your determination to reclaim Pales may lead to a case of history repeating."

255.speaker: Estela Toras
255.text: "Your attention should be on the rightful restoration of Zille, not Pales!"

256.speaker: Estela Toras
256.text: "You sound just like him. But I'll tell you what I *do* see..."

257.speaker: Estela Toras
257.text: “I see a son determined to embark on a military expedition when his attention should be focused on the rightful restoration of Zille.”

258.speaker: Estela Toras
258.text: “I see the very foundation of the monarchy being put at risk through such actions.”

259.speaker: Estela Toras
259.text: "The very foundation of the monarchy is being put at risk through such actions."

260.speaker: Estela Toras
260.text: "He chose the lesser of two evils. And in doing so, we retained the throne. The only mistake would have been inaction."

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: "Reclaiming Zille will honor his memory by finishing what he started."

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "Reclaiming Zille, God willing, will honor his memory by finishing what he started."

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "Surrendering Zille was one of Rizia's greatest tragedies. That's why I intend to do everything possible to see it returned."

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "Surrendering Zille was one of Rizia's greatest tragedies. That's why I intend to do everything possible to see it returned -- by any means necessary."

271.speaker: Estela Toras
271.text: "Your words would have been a source of pride for him, as they are with me."

272.speaker: Estela Toras
272.text: "As hard as it may be to accept, he took the necessary steps to secure the throne for us."

273.speaker: Estela Toras
273.text: "A noble resolve indeed. Your words would have been a source of pride for him, as they are with me."

274.speaker: Estela Toras
274.text: "As hard as it may be to accept, he did what needed to be done so that we would retain the throne."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "I pray she's found peace in the afterlife."

279.speaker: Player_Romus
279.text: "I hope she has found peace in whatever comes next."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "She gave me the greatest gift of all, Vina. For that, I will always be in her debt."

284.speaker: Estela Toras
284.text: "Love is a private sentiment, not a public performance. But yes, my affection toward Lena was quite strong."

285.speaker: Narrator
285.text: A fleeting smile hinted at a memory that briefly illuminated her thoughts.

286.speaker: Narrator
286.text: A momentary smile suggested a memory that fleetingly illuminated her mind.

287.speaker: Narrator
287.text: A passing smile hinted at a memory that briefly flickered through her thoughts.

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: A transient smile hinted at a memory that briefly crossed her thoughts.

289.speaker: Estela Toras
289.text: "A monarch must reign with compassion, or all will be lost."

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "I had no idea. So many lives were saved, thanks to that one conversation."

291.speaker: Estela Toras
291.text: "To think... if only she was around to talk to Wiktor Smolak now."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "A love letter? So the old man had a heart after all?"

296.speaker: Player_Romus
296.text: "A love letter? Somehow I have trouble picturing Father writing one of those."

300.speaker: Player_Romus
300.text: "Oh. For a moment there I thought you were handing me divorce paperwork."

302.speaker: Estela Toras
302.text: "It's five years and a heart attack too late for me to divorce Valero, darling."

303.speaker: Narrator
303.text: She took the envelope out of my hands and shoved it back into the bag.

307.speaker: Narrator
307.text: She shoved the letter back in her bag.

308.speaker: Estela Toras
308.text: "There's a lot you don't know about him. That you never bothered trying to learn."

309.speaker: Estela Toras
309.text: "There was far more to him than you know."

310.speaker: Estela Toras
310.text: "Come. Let's go pay him a visit."

312.speaker: Estela Toras
312.text: "It was only gathering dust in my writing desk. Come, let's pay him a visit."

313.speaker: Estela Toras
313.text: "That's between your father and me. Come, let's see what he's up to."

317.speaker: Player_Romus
317.text: "If this is becoming too much for you, I'll understand."

318.speaker: Estela Toras
318.text: "Your concern is appreciated, but I'll be fine."

320.speaker: Estela Toras
320.text: "Of course! That was never in doubt."

321.speaker: Estela Toras
321.text: "However, I'm pleased to hear your commitment to ensuring its return."

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "More like kicking the can down the road for others to clean up."

324.speaker: Player_Romus
324.text: "We can dwell on the loss until the end of time. What matters is our resilience to reclaim what's ours."

325.speaker: Player_Romus
325.text: "Maybe. But it doesn't make reclaiming it any easier."

326.speaker: Player_Romus
326.text: "A mistake is a mistake, not matter how you try to sugarcoat it."

327.speaker: Estela Toras
327.text: "No, I suppose not. But we must do what must be done to preserve our territorial integrity, not to mention our family name."

330.speaker: Estela Toras
330.text: "Which we must learn from to avoid repetition."

331.speaker: Estela Toras
331.text: "Though, of course, the further forward we move, the closer we may get to hitting a dead end."

332.speaker: Estela Toras
332.text: "Though I fear you'll have to learn that lesson yourself when it comes to Crown policy."

336.speaker: Estela Toras
336.text: "Your reforms to the monarchy are slowly chipping away at our most sacred institution. If you're not careful, I fear nothing will be left."

337.speaker: Player_Romus
337.text: "My reforms are for the good of the country. If anything our concessions will make our monarchy stronger."

338.speaker: Player_Romus
338.text: "We need to get with the times. If we don't evolve, we'll be left in the dust like all the other monarchies that have gone extinct."

339.speaker: Player_Romus
339.text: "Don't worry. I've got everything under control."

343.speaker: Player_Romus
343.text: "That's none of your concern. I know what I'm doing."

344.speaker: Player_Romus
344.text: "This is neither the time nor the place to discuss Crown policy. I don't wish to discuss it any further."

345.speaker: Estela Toras
345.text: "Very well. But given your concern for legacy, you're certainly risking tarnishing it with such reforms."

348.speaker: Estela Toras
348.text: "Those who believe they're in control often find themselves at the mercy of unforeseen circumstances, and risk losing it all."

349.speaker: Estela Toras
349.text: "If by putting the founding principles of the monarchy in jeopardy, then yes. I'd say you're succeeding on that end."

350.speaker: Estela Toras
350.text: "I'd say your policies imply that extinction is your goal. These reforms set a dangerous precedence and come with great risks."

351.speaker: Estela Toras
351.text: "You and I seem to have different definitions of what it means to be strong. From my vantage point, I'd say the opposite."

352.speaker: Estela Toras
352.text: "Taking such risks sets a dangerous precedence."

353.speaker: Estela Toras
353.text: "Which, I'm sorry to say, are slowly being chipped away. I fear that if we continue on this trajectory, there might be nothing substantial remaining."

360.speaker: Estela Toras
360.text: "Yes, darling, I've heard rumors that you may begin working with a certain someone on reforming the monarchy."

361.speaker: Estela Toras
361.text: "It's none of my business, of course. But it's bound to make you a host of enemies."

362.speaker: Estela Toras
362.text: "I've heard whispers about your *escapades* with House Azaro, a family harboring their own ambitions regarding the throne. And you know how risky rumors can be."

363.speaker: Narrator
363.text: It was then we heard the far distant rings of the bells of the Archsanctuary of Zilba begin to chime.

364.speaker: Estela Toras
364.text: "Right on cue. Shall we head to the ceremony?"

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "Yes, we wouldn't want to be late."

366.speaker: Estela Toras
366.text: "We're already late, but as king, that's your prerogative."

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "Right. Almost forgot all about it. I'm sure Vina is wondering where we are."

372.speaker: Narrator
372.text: Before departing, I cast a final glance at Father's resting place, and a rush of memories flooded my mind.

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "Before we part, know this -- I shape my own legacy, free from the expectations of a faded form. Father's views on my choices carry no weight."

374.speaker: Player_Romus
374.text: "In the spirit of transparency, know that I fully intend to reclaim Pales, rectifying Father's mistakes. While I understand you have your sights set on Zille, I believe this is what's best."

375.speaker: Player_Romus
375.text: "Before we go... you should know that I intend to uphold Father's legacy. I will do right by him by rejuvenating this nation in accordance with his wishes."

376.speaker: Player_Romus
376.text: "Since we're being forthright, I want you to know that I intend to preserve Father's legacy and do right by him. I vow to fulfill what he started by reclaiming Pales."

377.speaker: Estela Toras
377.text: "Very well. I trust you know what's best. I'll pray for you."

378.speaker: Estela Toras
378.text: "I understand. For what it's worth, as hard as it may be to believe, he would have been proud of you no matter what."

379.speaker: Estela Toras
379.text: "May your endeavors to rejuvenate our nation bring about the greatness he envisioned."

380.speaker: Estela Toras
380.text: "I can't help but feel a sense of skepticism and concern, but I trust in God, and I have faith that you'll succeed."

381.speaker: Estela Toras
381.text: "Then good luck to you then. Though, you're going to need more than luck to reclaim Pales."

385.speaker: Player_Romus
385.text: "Yes. Just give me a second alone with father."

387.speaker: Narrator
387.text: I took my mother's arm and we departed, leaving my father to his solitude.

398.speaker: Estela Toras
398.text: "Though for how long, is a question that lingers."

407.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
407.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_NoMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false

408.speaker: Estela Toras
408.text: "Though, I can't say the same for your commitment to reforming the monarchy, which is slowly chipping away at our most sacred institution."

409.speaker: Estela Toras
409.text: "If you're not careful, I fear nothing will be left by the time you're through."

413.speaker: Estela Toras
413.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_NoMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true)

416.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
416.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_NoMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false

417.speaker: Estela Toras
417.text: "However, I can't say the same toward your crusade to reform the monarchy."

418.speaker: Estela Toras
418.text: "If you're not careful, I fear nothing will be left to salvage by the time you're through."

422.speaker: Estela Toras
422.text: "However, I can't say the same across the board."
422.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_NoMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true)

423.speaker: Narrator
423.text: In the royal tradition, this was the resting place of the most recently deceased monarch of Rizia.

437.speaker: Estela Toras
437.text: "I so wish Vina could be here. She never got to know Lena the way I did."

444.speaker: Estela Toras
444.text: "Not to mention your misadventures in cooperation with the opposition party."

465.speaker: Player_Romus
465.text: "Isn't the allure of gossip beneath someone of your age and stature?"

466.speaker: Player_Romus
466.text: "Whispers and rumors... they hold no more substance than passing reflections."

467.speaker: Player_Romus
467.text: "The glow of divine providence renders whispers and rumors as transitory as sunlight on water."
467.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true)

468.speaker: Estela Toras
468.text: "Gossip is the fuel on which monarchies run. I thought you knew that already."

469.speaker: Estela Toras
469.text: "I see that instead of addressing my concern, you choose to deflect."

470.speaker: Estela Toras
470.text: "Fancy words. Almost as if you were trying to deflect from the rumors' substance."

471.speaker: Player_Romus
471.text: "Rumors are as fleeting as sunlight dancing on water."
471.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) == false)

486.speaker: Estela Toras
486.text: "Still, I expect nothing but discretion from both you and your daughter. Wouldn't want to risk stirring up too much gossip."

488.speaker: Estela Toras
488.text: "It requires us to face risks and challenges head-on, whether from hostile actors or simple gossip."

494.speaker: Estela Toras
494.text: "Which is why I'm expecting nothing but discretion from both you and your daughter. Wouldn't want to risk stirring up too much gossip."

496.speaker: Estela Toras
496.text: "We're sometimes required to face risks and challenges head-on, whether from hostile actors or simple gossip."

498.speaker: Estela Toras
498.text: "In life, we're sometimes required to face risks and challenges head-on, whether from hostile actors or simple gossip."
498.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_NoMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false)

500.speaker: Estela Toras
500.text: "Sometimes in life, we're required to face risks and challenges head-on, whether from hostile actors or simple gossip."
500.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_ConstitutionalMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn02_Intention_NoMonarchy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reforms_DiscussedOnYacht"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false)

507.speaker: Narrator
507.text: She embraced her granddaughter, then held her at arm's length.

508.speaker: Estela Toras
508.text: "Vina! I'm so glad you made it back to Rizia in time to pay your respects."

509.speaker: Vina Toras
509.text: "Grandmother! I will remind you that I'm spoken for."

513.speaker: Player_Romus
513.text: "It may be hard to believe, but your mother's death was part of God's plan. We should not question His designs, only trust in His wisdom."

515.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
515.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true

516.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
516.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false

517.speaker: Player_Romus
517.text: "We still have each other. You don't know how scared I was of losing you during the Pales incident."
517.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true

521.speaker: Player_Romus
521.text: "Acknowledging that you were responsible for the death of the love of my life won't bring comfort to either of us."

522.speaker: Player_Romus
522.text: "It could have been worse. I could've lost you as well."
522.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Border"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Incident_Naval"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false

523.speaker: Vina Toras
523.text: "Trust goes both ways, Father. What has God done to earn ours?"

527.speaker: Vina Toras
527.text: "You were never in danger of losing me, Father. I can take care of myself."

530.speaker: Vina Toras
530.text: "I know. But I still can't help but feel that letting it go would mean letting her down."

531.speaker: Estela Toras
531.text: "I'd say your time among the Palesians has done wonders for you. You've lost weight."

536.speaker: Vina Toras
536.text: "If I did, it was by accident. I ate very well over there, even after the incident."

537.speaker: Vina Toras
537.text: "If I did, it was by accident. I ate very well over there."

538.speaker: Estela Toras
538.text: "Candlelit dinners with His Grace? Do tell me more."

542.speaker: Vina Toras
542.text: "Grandmother! Don't tell me you believed those rumors."

546.speaker: Player_Romus
546.text: "I understand. His duties as a delegate must keep him quite busy."

547.speaker: Vina Toras
547.text: "We'll catch up later. I'm meeting Manus for a walk before the ceremony."

548.speaker: Estela Toras
548.text: "What rumors? All I know is that if I were alone with that man, an energy partnership wouldn't be the only deal sealed--"

552.speaker: Estela Toras
552.text: “Neither did you, I suspect, or you'd be sobbing by her graveside right now. She was an extraordinary woman."

553.speaker: Player_Romus
553.text: "I liked her enough. We just never felt a spark."

554.speaker: Estela Toras
554.text: "Perhaps you resented your arranged marriage so much that you did not allow yourself to feel it."

555.speaker: Player_Romus
555.text: "Oh, I remember. You never met a noblewoman you didn't disparage."

556.speaker: Estela Toras
556.text: "I was insecure, darling. Even after my status was secured, I never got over the feeling that I was an imposter."

557.speaker: Estela Toras
557.text: "Except around Her Highness. That was part of the reason I loved her."

558.speaker: Estela Toras
558.text: "For my part, I grew to love her dearly."

559.speaker: Player_Romus
559.text: "A shame you could never hold your tongue around her sister."

560.speaker: Estela Toras
560.text: "Beatrice never had it easy. Shouldering the responsibility of ruling Rumburg while her gorgeous younger sibling absorbed the limelight."

561.speaker: Estela Toras
561.text: "But if anyone deserved it, she did."

565.speaker: Estela Toras
565.text: “It was right after the civil war broke out in Wehlen."

572.speaker: Player_Romus
572.text: "Lena's naivete overlooked the full implications of welcoming all those foreigners."

573.speaker: Estela Toras
573.text: "No. She thought about their humanity and the horrors they faced, at a time when few other nobles did."

574.speaker: Player_Romus
574.text: "What do you think she'd make of my decision to go to war with Pales?"

575.speaker: Estela Toras
575.text: "Good question. I suppose we'll never know."

579.speaker: Estela Toras
579.text: "Remember that as we enter into war, Romus."

580.speaker: Estela Toras
580.text: "A lesson we'd all do well to remember, Romus."

584.speaker: Estela Toras
584.text: "That's a shame. Who knows how many valuable insights were lost when that boat capsized."

585.speaker: Player_Romus
585.text: "You've described her exactly. Whenever I make a royal decision, I try to see the humane side of it. The way she would."

586.speaker: Estela Toras
586.text: "Who knows what insights she would have to contribute if she were alive today."

587.speaker: Estela Toras
587.text: "Lena and I had much in common besides political opinions, too. We both took a single ice cube in our red wine on hot days..."

588.speaker: Player_Romus
588.text: "Your grandmother's exaggerating, Vina. She didn't know your mother at all."

589.speaker: Player_Romus
589.text: "Really, Mother? 'Like a daughter'? You never met a noblewoman you didn't disparage."

590.speaker: Estela Toras
590.text: "I was insecure, darling. Even after my status was secured, I never got over the feeling that I was an imposter."

591.speaker: Estela Toras
591.text: "Except around Her Highness. That was part of the reason I loved her."

592.speaker: Estela Toras
592.text: "We conversed much more often than you realized. You were just too busy to notice."

593.speaker: Estela Toras
593.text: "Believe me when I say that I did grow to love her."

594.speaker: Player_Romus
594.text: "I had no idea you felt that way about her."

595.speaker: Estela Toras
595.text: "Come now. You know I'm not one for garish displays of emotion."

596.speaker: Estela Toras
596.text: "But it's true. I did grow to love her dearly."

597.speaker: Player_Romus
597.text: "Lena won over every person she met. Even prickly Queen Consorts."

598.speaker: Estela Toras
598.text: "Ha! I confess it took me a while to get over my prejudices about Rumburgian nobles."

601.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
601.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

602.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
602.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_Approve"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_VinaManus_ApproveAfterPales"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

604.speaker: Player_Romus
604.text: "Your mother's passing was a part of life. It's important to find strength in the memories and support each other through these challenging times."

605.speaker: Vina Toras
605.text: "I'm not sure memories are enough to give me strength."

606.speaker: Narrator
606.text: Since she was taken, I'd endured many sleepless nights.

607.speaker: Estela Toras
607.text: "Yes, the Livingstons are as traditionalist as they come, but there's much we mothers are willing to overlook for the sake of our children's happiness--"

608.speaker: Estela Toras
608.text: "You two were at Palas Rezna for dinner, and Lena and I absconded for tea after you and your father got into another one of your rows."

609.speaker: Estela Toras
609.text: "You two were at Palas Rezna for dinner, and Lena and I absconded for tea after you and your father went off to talk."

610.speaker: Estela Toras
610.text: "But as we discussed the situation, your wife made such a convincing case for empathy and kindness that I was literally moved to tears."

611.speaker: Estela Toras
611.text: "She had this way of seeing past politics, straight to the heart of the matter."

612.speaker: Narrator
612.text: When I died, I would take my father's place beside the Eternal Flame, and he would be laid to rest among his forebears.

613.speaker: Estela Toras
613.text: "Through triumphs and tribulations, you were my confidante, my partner, my solace."

614.speaker: Estela Toras
614.text: "I loved you then, I love you now."

618.speaker: Player_Romus
618.text: "Indeed. Recognizing the influence of the past on the present is crucial."

622.speaker: Player_Romus
622.text: "I appreciate your concern, but this time will be different."

623.speaker: Estela Toras
623.text: "Relying solely on divine intervention is misguided. Speaking of which, your attention should be on the rightful restoration of Zille, not Pales."

625.speaker: Player_Romus
625.text: "Since we're being honest with one another... Know that Father's legacy and opinions of me are of no concern. But I'm determined to correct his mistakes by achieving what he couldn't."

638.speaker: Estela Toras
638.text: "Your father declaring war must have been quite the appetite suppressant."

644.speaker: Narrator
644.text: I saw her lip tremble slightly. Mother squeezed her shoulder in silent support.

645.speaker: Narrator
645.text: Soon, I found her sarcophagus, encased in gold as per tradition.

652.speaker: Player_Romus
652.text: "You're making a fuss over nothing, Mother. The Duke and I had the deal clinched. Vina's involvement was merely ornamental."

653.speaker: Estela Toras
653.text: "If anyone deserves to settle down with a nice husband, it's her."

662.speaker: Estela Toras
662.text: "I know she would've been proud of the person you've become, Vina."

663.speaker: Estela Toras
663.text: "I know you have approved of Manus and Vina, and I support passion, but it might not be as digestible for the rest of the house."

664.speaker: Estela Toras
664.text: "Look at how you handled yourself in Pales. The perfect example of royal grace and dignity."

665.speaker: Player_Romus
665.text: "Yes, she has indeed shown remarkable strength and resilience."

666.speaker: Estela Toras
666.text: "Poor dear... she's been through so much."

676.speaker: Player_Romus
676.text: "You're right. I didn't need to react that way. I will speak to her about it later."

677.speaker: Player_Romus
677.text: "She'll be fine. Don't worry about her."

678.speaker: Player_Romus
678.text: "I'll parent my way, and you parent yours."

679.speaker: Estela Toras
679.text: "I wouldn't call that parenting. I'd call it imposing your will without considering the consequences."

680.speaker: Estela Toras
680.text: "Well, it was. Unless your goal is to get her to resent you."

681.speaker: Player_Romus
681.text: "Yes, that's *exactly* what I want to do. What better way to forge better family ties than to encourage resentment?"

682.speaker: Player_Romus
682.text: "You're making a fuss over nothing, Mother. A true diplomat wouldn't have caused an international incident like Vina did."

683.speaker: Narrator
683.text: Despite Vina's attempts to conceal her emotions, the subtle quiver in her lips and a deep sigh betrayed her inner turmoil.

686.speaker: Narrator
686.text: Vina hurried out of the room before anyone could respond.

688.speaker: Narrator
688.text: Even as Vina tried to conceal her feelings, a subtle tremor in her lips and a heavy sigh betrayed her inner turmoil.

689.speaker: Estela Toras
689.text: "I'm her grandmother. It's my job to worry, as should you."

690.speaker: Player_Romus
690.text: "That's very kind of you, Mother. Vina indeed handled herself like a true princess."

691.speaker: Narrator
691.text: Vina's lip trembled. I saw outrage in her eyes.

692.speaker: Estela Toras
692.text: "Sarcasm doesn't suit you. It's beneath the dignity expected of a king."

693.speaker: Player_Romus
693.text: "Watch your tone. I am your king."

694.speaker: Player_Romus
694.text: "Vina is free to marry whomever she chooses. You, of all people, should understand the importance of love and following one's heart."

695.speaker: Estela Toras
695.text: "Good. This family has enough problems as it is. No need to create more."

696.speaker: Estela Toras
696.text: "And I am your mother. If anybody's tone needs watching, it's yours."

697.speaker: Estela Toras
697.text: "I wouldn't be so sure of that. Grudges have a funny way of never going away."

698.speaker: Player_Romus
698.text: "What's done is done. I'm sure she'll forget all about it and forgive me in no time."

699.speaker: Player_Romus
699.text: "I agree. Unfortunately, I suspect she still has her heart set on Manus."

700.speaker: Player_Romus
700.text: "I couldn't agree more. However, it seems this kingdom lacks suitable men of good stature."

701.speaker: Estela Toras
701.text: "I don't need a lecture on the importance of love and freedom, thank you."

702.speaker: Estela Toras
702.text: "Either way, our girl needs to tie the knot sooner rather than later for our family to secure its place on the throne."

703.speaker: Estela Toras
703.text: "Then maybe you should start looking outside the kingdom. To Pales, perhaps..."

704.speaker: Estela Toras
704.text: "Then perhaps you should start looking outside the kingdom."

705.speaker: Player_Romus
705.text: "I keep coming back to the same answer. The only way to ensure our stability is to marry her off within House Toras."

709.speaker: Estela Toras
709.text: "Love has its own stubborn ways, and letting go can be an arduous task. Yet, duty often requires sacrifice -- the Princess should know that."

710.speaker: Estela Toras
710.text: "That trigger should be pulled only out of desperation, dear. I don't think we're there yet."

711.speaker: Estela Toras
711.text: "Losing a parent is hard, especially when they love you as much as Vina's mother loved her."

712.speaker: Estela Toras
712.text: "It's about time we consider wedding bells for Vina if we want to ensure the continuation of our lineage."

713.speaker: Estela Toras
713.text: "In any case, I'm pleased that Vina's looking well, all things considered. She's been through so much."

719.speaker: Narrator
719.text: Her gaze once again landed on Lena's resting place.

723.speaker: Narrator
723.text: As she spoke, a memory suddenly came to me.

724.speaker: Estela Toras
724.text: "But let's get to the reason why I'm here."

725.speaker: Narrator
725.text: Lena had just completed the Rite of Severance, the ceremony converting her to Wruhecism.

726.speaker: Narrator
726.text: After she'd burned the last of the eleven slips of parchment representing her connection to Dastnurity, my mother was the first to approach and embrace her.

727.speaker: Narrator
727.text: I hadn't thought much about it at the time. But knowing what I did now...

728.speaker: Player_Romus
728.text: "Did my wife know you were a Dastnurist?"

732.speaker: Player_Romus
732.text: "Wine? No, what you two shared was an attachment to your heathen faith."

733.speaker: Player_Romus
733.text: "There's something I need to bring up with you. Have you secretly been practicing Dastnurity?"

734.speaker: Player_Romus
734.text: "Please, enough about Lena. This is already a very emotional day for me."

735.speaker: Narrator
735.text: My mother went pale as a sheet.

736.speaker: Estela Toras
736.text: "Emotional, Romus? You haven't seen anything yet."

738.speaker: Estela Toras
738.text: “I don’t know what you’re talking about.”

739.speaker: Player_Romus
739.text: "Please. I'm not judging you. I just want you to be honest with me.”

740.speaker: Estela Toras
740.text: “It’s called faith for a reason. It's not something you casually discard."

741.speaker: Player_Romus
741.text: "Don't lie to me! Do you take me for a fool? I know all about it."

742.speaker: Player_Romus
742.text: "Titus told me where you where the night Father died."

743.speaker: Player_Romus
743.text: "Come on, Mother. I know all about it."

747.speaker: Player_Romus
747.text: "Well, that's a relief. I guess I can close the case on that one. What was I thinking?"

748.speaker: Estela Toras
748.text: "You had me investigated? Your own mother?!"

749.speaker: Estela Toras
749.text: "Don't take that tone with me! You may be king, but I'm still your mother."

750.speaker: Narrator
750.text: Mother stood firm, her gaze unfaltering. Yet, it took only a short while before she yielded, heaving a sigh of resignation.

754.speaker: Player_Romus
754.text: "Lucita told me where you where the night Father died."

758.speaker: Estela Toras
758.text: "Oh, I highly doubt you're not judging me, son."

759.speaker: Estela Toras
759.text: "The same Lucita who's in jail for crimes against the state?"

763.speaker: Player_Romus
763.text: "It is if you want to be part of the Rizian Royal Family. Why couldn't you have made the same sacrifice Lena did?"

764.speaker: Player_Romus
764.text: "Was your whole family Dastnurist? How could you have kept this a secret for so long?"

765.speaker: Player_Romus
765.text: "I understand. But I wish I hadn't found out this way. You should have trusted me enough to tell me."

766.speaker: Estela Toras
766.text: "I'm sorry I felt compelled to hide it all these years. But I did it to protect you."

767.speaker: Estela Toras
767.text: "Marrying your father was enough of a scandal. Can you imagine the uproar my religion would've caused on top of that?"

768.speaker: Estela Toras
768.text: "My intention was to shield you from danger, even if it meant keeping a part of myself hidden."

769.speaker: Estela Toras
769.text: "But as king, and more importantly, as my son, you had a right to know."

770.speaker: Estela Toras
770.text: "Sacrifice and compromise are values drilled into princesses, my dear. Not fisherman's daughters."

771.speaker: Estela Toras
771.text: "Only my grandmother, God rest her soul."

772.speaker: Estela Toras
772.text: "She used to take me to Dastnurist services behind my parents' back. I kept up the habit after she died -- not regularly, but whenever I could."

773.speaker: Estela Toras
773.text: "My late grandmother used to take me to the Dastnurist sanctuary in Zille behind my parents' back. Our little secret, she called it."

774.speaker: Estela Toras
774.text: "To turn my back on Dastnurity would be to betray her memory. Or that's what it feels like."

778.speaker: Player_Romus
778.text: "Listen to me, Mother. You have to convert before it's too late."

780.speaker: Estela Toras
780.text: "Can't you just keep this between us two?"

781.speaker: Player_Romus
781.text: "To hell with your grandma's memory. What about betraying your son?"

782.speaker: Player_Romus
782.text: "If she was alive when you were crowned Princess Consort, she would have told you to convert."

784.speaker: Player_Romus
784.text: "You don't have to hide anymore. I am building a Rizia where all branches of the Nurist faith are equally welcome."

788.speaker: Player_Romus
788.text: "You don't have to hide anymore. I am building a Rizia where no religion dominates over any other."

792.speaker: Player_Romus
792.text: "Thank you for your honesty. And don't worry. Nobody else has to know about this."

793.speaker: Player_Romus
793.text: "Now that your secret's out, I implore you to convert to Wruhecism."

794.speaker: Player_Romus
794.text: "I can't believe Lena never told me."

798.speaker: Estela Toras
798.text: "You two were never exactly forthright with each other, were you?"

799.speaker: Estela Toras
799.text: "She wanted to. I swore her to secrecy, the poor dear."

800.speaker: Estela Toras
800.text: "I'm an old lady, darling. And I'm more set in my ways than an eel in aspic."

801.speaker: Estela Toras
801.text: "Oh, I know. And I'm grateful for it, believe me."

802.speaker: Estela Toras
802.text: "Oh, I know. And I imagine Grand Wiseman Ignacius was just thrilled with that little decree."

803.speaker: Estela Toras
803.text: "But tradition is tradition, and I've already caused enough fusses to last a lifetime. So I'd prefer this little revelation stay between us."

807.speaker: Narrator
807.text: Her eyes flicked towards the mausoleum entrance, where the Golden Guard stood watch.

812.speaker: Estela Toras
812.text: "After all, the only other person who knows can't go blabbing to anyone but the Citadel walls."

813.speaker: Estela Toras
813.text: "And your lovely falcon of a war councilor, I suppose."

817.speaker: Estela Toras
817.text: "After all, the only other person who knows can't go blabbing to anyone but the Citadel walls."

818.speaker: Player_Romus
818.text: "Very well, I won't tell anyone. But it goes without saying that you've shattered my trust."

819.speaker: Player_Romus
819.text: "I won't force you to convert. But for your own sake, please be more careful in concealing your faith."

820.speaker: Player_Romus
820.text: "Your secret is safe. But I do pray that in due time, you'll see the error of your ways and return to the one true faith."

826.speaker: Player_Romus
826.text: "You don't have to hide anymore. I am building a Rizia where Dastnurity can flourish, regardless of our state religion."
826.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Happy"] == true)

830.speaker: Player_Romus
830.text: "You don't have to hide anymore. Actually, revealing your religion might boost my popularity with the Dastnurist community."
830.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Law_NurityStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveStateReligion"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Happy"] == true) == false)

832.speaker: Estela Toras
832.text: "Tradition is tradition, and I've already caused enough fusses to last a lifetime. So I'd prefer this little revelation stay between us."

833.speaker: Narrator
833.text: She put a hand to her chest and sighed in relief.

834.speaker: Estela Toras
834.text: "I appreciate it, Romus. I really do."

835.speaker: Player_Romus
835.text: "Please, Mother. If you love me, you'll do this for me."

836.speaker: Player_Romus
836.text: "I am building a new Rizia. One in which the Wruhecist faith triumphs over all others. Everyone must see the light, the Queen Mother included."

840.speaker: Player_Romus
840.text: "More people know your secret than just us two. It's only a matter of time before it's made public."

844.speaker: Estela Toras
844.text: "My dear, if you don't trust your investigators to keep a secret, you shouldn't have trusted them with an investigation in the first place."

845.speaker: Estela Toras
845.text: "My son over my faith... it's an impossible choice, Romus."

847.speaker: Narrator
847.text: She twisted a ring on one of her fingers.

848.speaker: Estela Toras
848.text: "I presume you haven't told the Rumburgians about these plans yet..."

849.speaker: Estela Toras
849.text: "But never mind that. If it's really so important to you, I'll do it."

850.speaker: Estela Toras
850.text: "Well, when you manage to put it back together again, let me know."

851.speaker: Estela Toras
851.text: "I was doing just fine before you brought a security team into it."

852.speaker: Estela Toras
852.text: "Pray away, my son. This soul's already a lost cause, anyway."

853.speaker: Estela Toras
853.text: "Now, as for the reason I'm here."

856.speaker: Estela Toras
856.text: "But if it's really so important to you, I'll do it."

857.speaker: Narrator
857.text: She recomposed herself and made an effort to smile.

858.speaker: Player_Romus
858.text: "Thank you, Mother. You won't regret it."

859.speaker: Player_Romus
859.text: "Wait. I don't want to force you to become a Wruhecist for my sake. I only hope you'll come to the decision on your own."

860.speaker: Narrator
860.text: She put a hand to her chest and sighed in relief.

863.speaker: Estela Toras
863.text: "Next chance I get, I'll march down to Zilba and have one of the Wisemen there make a believer out of me."

866.speaker: Player_Romus
866.text: “Let's leave it at that. I'm not in the mood for conversation."

867.speaker: Narrator
867.text: She stepped towards my father's resting place and spoke to him in a hushed whisper, prolonging the conversation far longer than I anticipated.

869.speaker: Narrator
869.text: She kissed me on the cheek and patted my shoulder.

871.speaker: Narrator
871.text: Mother went on ahead of me while I remained behind to have a final moment with Father.

876.speaker: Narrator
876.text: Once alone, I reached into my inner jacket pocket and took out an envelope -- the last letter my father ever wrote to me.

877.speaker: Narrator
877.text: "Find your own way, my son, and let your journey be yours alone — not a reflection of mine."

879.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
879.text: Place the letter into the fire.

883.speaker: Narrator
883.text: I departed soon after, leaving my father to his solitude.

887.speaker: Narrator
887.text: I struggled to remember his face or the last words he spoke to me.
887.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_DadLetter_ThrowAway"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_DadLetter"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_DadLetter_ThrowAway"] == true)

888.speaker: Narrator
888.text: I remembered his last words to me as if he'd spoken them yesterday.
888.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_DadLetter_ThrowAway"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_DadLetter"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_DadLetter_ThrowAway"] == true) == false)

890.speaker: Player_Romus
890.text: "I vow that I will rectify your mistakes. I will reclaim Pales and become the greatest king Rizia has ever known."

891.speaker: Player_Romus
891.text: "I will do right by you, Father. I will rejuvenate this nation the way you always wanted."

892.speaker: Player_Romus
892.text: "The Rizian flag shall fly over Pales in your honor, Father."

893.speaker: Estela Toras
893.text: "May your endeavors to rejuvenate our nation bring about the greatness he envisioned."

900.speaker: Player_Romus
900.text: "I don't give a damn about your legacy or what you thought about me. I have my own path to walk."

903.speaker: Player_Romus
903.text: "I vow that I will rectify your mistakes. I will take back Zille and become the greatest king Rizia has ever known."
